sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product AS p JOIN production.productsubcategory AS s ON p.productsubcategoryid = s.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory AS c ON s.productcategoryid = c.productcategoryid GROUP BY c.productcategoryid, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 200
